generation_reason: V2 retest limit improved V1 materially but remained negative net of costs. V3 keeps the same SHORT compression/breakout event and adds a causal post-retest rejection confirmation before entry.

data.timeframe: 15m parent + official Binance 1m chronology for exit collisions
data.validation: 2025-2026 SEEN validation; not read by this TRAIN run
data.universe: all symbol files in frozen source artifacts
data.point_in_time_universe_status: unknown; survivorship/listing eligibility audit required before VALIDATED_CANDIDATE

signal.compression: ATR16/ATR96 <= 0.65, using data completed before signal bar
signal.first_breakout_guard: previous close inside its own prior-16-bar box
signal.breakout: signal bar close < prior box low

retest.retest_touch: first post-signal 15m bar with high >= retest level; only completed-bar information is used for later confirmation

confirmation.SIGNAL_CLOSE: after retest touch, first completed 15m bar with close < original signal close
confirmation.RETEST_LOW: after retest touch, first completed 15m bar with close < low of the first retest-touch bar
confirmation.entry: next 15m bar OPEN after confirmation bar; taker/open fill

exits.time_exit: close of final allowed 15m bar, V1/V2-compatible

execution.chronology: AGENTS.md section 11 canonical official Binance 1m resolution for same-parent-bar TP/SL ambiguity
execution.entry_chronology: entry occurs only at a bar open after confirmation; no pre-entry exit touch counts

portfolio.priority: entry_time asc, expansion_strength desc, compression_strength desc, symbol asc

gates: at least 3/4 calendar years positive at 20bp
at least one adjacent grid config PF20 > 1.03 and ret20 > 0
selection.ranking: ret20 desc, MDD20 asc, PF40 desc, executable N desc
selection.if_pass: freeze robust TRAIN region before revealing 2025-2026 validation
selection.if_fail: preserve failure; do not mine validation
